final_interpretation_language: This report measures exact decoded-query performance after a declared per-task adaptation protocol. It does not establish reasoning, a shared latent rule z, cross-task pretraining, shortcut absence, or ARC benchmark performance beyond the fixed ten-task readout.
fresh_rerun_rule: For task ten or any not recoverable task, run exactly one fresh FULL Phase1-style solve using seed 20260702, condition F1, 1500 steps, existing phase1_condition_solver.py, and existing train.take_step.
manifest_path_correction_note: Corrected Windows D:/ paths to WSL /mnt/d paths before any fresh execution.
purpose: Bounded exact decoded-query performance readout for ten fixed ARC tasks after declared per-task adaptation protocol.
recovery_selection_rule: For each fixed first-nine task, use existing seed 20260702 condition F1 FULL run if solver.json is RUN_COMPLETED with 1500 steps and probability.npz exists; otherwise try seed 20260702 condition F2; otherwise mark NOT_RECOVERABLE.
